parameters.content:
## Endpoint health check

Checks a list of URLs on a schedule and emails **once** when something is down.

Two things make this different from a loop that emails on every failure:

1. **Every target is checked before anything is reported.** `neverError` keeps a dead endpoint from aborting the run, so one outage cannot hide the others.
2. **One digest, not one email per failure.** Ten dead endpoints is one message. An inbox with ten alerts in it is an inbox nobody reads.

Edit the list in `[H1] Targets`. Set `ALERT_TO` and attach an SMTP credential to `[H5] Send Digest`.

**Not included on purpose:** flap suppression. If an endpoint is down for a day this sends a message every run. Add a state table before pointing it at anything noisy.

nodes.name: [H2] Probe
nodes.notes: neverError is the point: a 500 or a timeout has to come back as data so the run continues to the next target.

nodes.name: [H5] Send Digest
nodes.notes: Needs an SMTP credential selecting in the UI.

nodes.name: [H6] All Clear
nodes.notes: Silence is the success case. Nothing is sent when everything is up.
